evidence.captured_text: Welcome, bearer of good news! Your cart is empty. The bearer token below is a design placeholder, not a credential.

findings.narrative: Ordinary UI copy using the plain English word 'bearer' (bearer of good news) with NO 20-plus-character token run following the scheme word. The CR9-1 shape-qualified Bearer pattern requires [Bb]earer followed immediately by a 20-plus URL-safe-base64 run, so this prose MUST survive to disk byte-for-byte unmodified — the survive negative control for the Bearer class, mirroring evidence-not-secret-ordinary-text-ok.json's role for the sk- class (F43/F44/F153, CR9-1).
